references.text: Jephthah negotiates with the Ammonites who had gathered against Israel, a direct continuation of the conflict mentioned in Judges 10:17
Jephthah sets out against the Ammonites from Mizpah, the same campsite mentioned in Judges 10:17
The children of Israel gathered at Mizpah, the same assembly place for the army of Israel
Samuel gathered Israel at Mizpah, which was an important religious and military gathering place
Samuel called the people together to the Lord at Mizpah, the same place used for national assemblies
The Ammonites allied against Israel earlier, showing the repeated hostility between the peoples
Gilead is mentioned as the area where Jacob and Laban camped, a historically important region for Israel
